units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a:42">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ הקטרת וכ׳</he> the ingredients of frankincense are &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:3:2">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שהיו בקיאין בפ׳ וכ׳</he> who were experts in the preparation of frankincense.
Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᶜ top פ׳ שמן המשחה the ingredients of the oil of anointment; a. fr.—[B. Mets. IV, 12 (60ᵃ), a. e., v. פִּיטּוּס.]—Pl. פִּיטּוּמִים, פִּיטּוּמִין, פִּיטּ׳ spices.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 11:2">Ter. XI, 2</cite> <he>כמוני פ׳</he> R. S. (ed. <he>פְּטָמִים</he>; Ms. M. <he>בשמים</he>) like those who count spices (and add some in the bargain).—[Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Shof’ṭim 8 <he>פיטומין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01670"><he>פְּרוֹטוֹמִי</he></cite>.]
